topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture by introducing complement and framing its significance and complexity.

topics.label: Introduction and core concepts of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the overall structure, naming conventions, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms of the alternative, lectin, and classical pathways that trigger complement activation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how complement mediates pathogen elimination and inflammatory responses through opsonization, peptide mediators, and membrane attack complexes.

topics.label: Regulation of complement activation and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors and mechanisms that restrain complement activation to protect host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the distinct disease presentations and clinical impacts associated with specific complement pathway deficiencies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens counteract complement defenses, focusing on the evasion strategies used by Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of next session
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and outlines the topic for the subsequent class.
